# `task_batch_validate`

**Check a task batch.** Run the deterministic ingestion-batch checks against the live graph and report hard, retryable and advisory findings without writing anything.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `task_batch_validate` |
| Side effect | `read` |
| Idempotency | natural |
| Retry safe | yes |
| Timeout | none |
| Preview | not supported |
